card.name: Drug interaction effects on levels
card.fires_on: Spots in drug-interaction text where a change in drug levels or dose is about to be stated, often partway through an interacting drug's name or in numbers like 2.5. Also fires on words like "resulted in" or "increase" before a percent change.

modes.label: Inside interacting drug names
modes.description: Partway through the name of a co-administered drug, before the effect on levels is stated.
modes.example: Concentrations of nelfinavir were decreased when coadministered with nevirap<<ine>>.

modes.label: Change wording and numbers
modes.description: Words or digits leading into an increase or decrease in levels or dose.
modes.example: concomitant administration of diflunisal and acetaminophen resulted in an approximate 50%<< increase>> in plasma levels of acetaminophen

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words meaning increase or enhance, such as 增加 and enhancing.
card.plain: It lights up when a label is about to say one drug raises or changes the levels of another.
